patches_modified.name: Marketplace only

patches_modified.name: Open Messenger from the top bar
patches_modified.description: Makes the Messenger icon at the top of Facebook open the Messenger app instead of Facebook's own Chats, if you'd rather chat in Messenger. Without Messenger installed, Chats opens as before. Starts off. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Chats. patches_modified.name: Tab bar at the bottom
patches_modified.description: Moves Facebook's tab bar to the bottom of the screen on accounts that have it at the top, where it's easier to reach. Turn it on in Hushfacebook settings > Appearance, then restart Facebook.

patches_added.name: Remove Update Prompt
patches_added.description: Removes byAir's forced-update screen ("Pack up for Update! 🚀" / "Update Now") by pinning its version gate to "no update required". byAir fetches a server-side minimum version code on launch and, if your build is older, blocks the whole app behind a non-dismissible screen whose only action opens Google Play. With the gate closed a patched older build keeps running and never calls the min-version endpoint, so you no longer have to re-patch every time byAir ships a release.

patches_modified.name: Enable Online Pro
patches_modified.description: Experimental companion patch that keeps byAir's online Pro gates open without forcing the crash-prone global entitlement refresh path.

patches_modified.name: Enable Pro
patches_modified.description: Suppresses the main byAir paywall, unlock banners, local user gating, and the notifications preferences "All" gate.

patches_modified.name: Unlock Premium
patches_modified.description: Forces the premium entitlement in Native Camera. Premium status is a local 'is_premium' SharedPreferences flag (in the 'rawcam_prefs' file) read on cold start into a StateFlow. Unlocks RAW DNG, 10-bit/HLG/UHDR video, custom boosted modes and the sub-40-Mbps bitrate cap. It also neutralizes PairIP's Play Store licensing (fired from both Application.attachBaseContext and LicenseContentProvider.onCreate, so a repacked copy no longer gets bounced to the Play Store paywall at launch).

patches_modified.name: Remove License Activity
patches_modified.description: Removes the PairIP LicenseActivity from AndroidManifest.xml so the app runs without a valid Play Store license (required because the APK is re-signed during patching).

patches_modified.name: Unlock Edge
patches_modified.description: Unlocks the Fricam Edge feature for free. Edge is a self-hosted companion sidecar that runs beside your Frigate NVR and streams low-latency + AI-detection frames into the app over WebRTC. Unlike Pro there is no local persistence for Edge: on every RevenueCat sync the app recomputes the "fricam_edge" entitlement and publishes it into an in-memory StateFlow that drives the pairing/settings/diagnostics UI. The patch forces that published flag true so the Edge UI and the self-hosted (edge-local / Frigate-direct) routes open without a subscription. Note: Fricam's managed Cloudflare relay (edge-remote, monthly allowance) is authenticated server-side and is not bypassed - run the open-source sidecar yourself to get the full value.

patches_modified.name: Unlock Premium
patches_modified.description: Unlocks all Fricam Pro features for free. Fricam's Pro state terminates in a plain SharedPreferences boolean (pro_unlocked in fricam_billing) written by a single PurchaseManager writer; every UI feature gate re-reads it via the static master ProGate. Fingerprints anchor on the stable prefs keys + signatures, so they survive the R8 class/method renames between 1.3.x and 1.4.0.1. The patch forces the RevenueCat entitlement check and the master gate to always return true (layered P1+P2), hardens the persist path so no refresh can downgrade, and neutralizes the PairIP Play Store license check that gates the app on launch.

patches_modified.name: Block Ad Server
patches_modified.description: Stops Nepali Patro's ads. Eight byte-asserted edits to libapp.so plus an in-place host rewrite: the ad-only host ads-delivery.nepalipatro.com.np is rewritten to an unresolvable .xx domain of the same length; the interstitial_html dispatch in the ad-queue callback is retargeted so the full-screen page is never pushed; showHtmlInterstitialAdDialog - the single function that raises the HTML interstitial roadblock - is stubbed out; the popup/popup_html branch is forced down the app's own 'blocked' return; and the five raster formats (slider, banner, popup, card_view, circular) are dropped to the build's own empty-widget tail, so the image creatives Remove Ads cannot see - they are fetched by Dart through CachedNetworkImage, not by a WebView - are never requested at all. The host rewrite alone is not enough: the ad URLs are also cached in SharedPreferences under PREF_SLIDER_DATA, and whether to present the shell at all comes from remote config, which the app rewrites on every launch. Pairs with Remove Ads, which stops the HTML creatives and the AdMob interstitials.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stops Nepali Patro's interstitial ads. Two edits to libapp.so: the ad-only host ads-delivery.nepalipatro.com.np is rewritten to an unresolvable .xx domain of the same length, and AdsBloc::featureInterstitialAdWithHtmlPopup - the single callee behind all 24 interstitial call sites - is forced down its existing 'popup blocked' return, so the full-screen ad page and its countdown never open. The host rewrite alone is not enough: the ad URLs are also cached in SharedPreferences under PREF_SLIDER_DATA, and whether to show the page at all comes from remote config, which the app rewrites on every launch. Pairs with Remove Ads, which stops the ad content itself and the AdMob interstitials.

Eight byte-asserted edits to libapp.so plus an in-place host rewrite: the ad-only host ads-delivery.nepalipatro.com.np is rewritten to an unresolvable .xx domain of the same length; the interstitial_html dispatch in the ad-queue callback is retargeted so the full-screen page is never pushed; showHtmlInterstitialAdDialog - the single function that raises the HTML interstitial roadblock - is stubbed out; the popup/popup_html branch is forced down the app's own 'blocked' return; and the five raster formats (slider, banner, popup, card_view, circular) are dropped to the build's own empty-widget tail, so the image creatives Remove Ads cannot see - they are fetched by Dart through CachedNetworkImage, not by a WebView - are never requested at all. The host rewrite alone is not enough: the ad URLs are also cached in SharedPreferences under PREF_SLIDER_DATA, and whether to present the shell at all comes from remote config, which the app rewrites on every launch. Pairs with Remove Ads, which stops the HTML creatives and the AdMob interstitials.
patches_modified.previous_description: Stops Nepali Patro's interstitial ads. Two edits to libapp.so: the ad-only host ads-delivery.nepalipatro.com.np is rewritten to an unresolvable .xx domain of the same length, and AdsBloc::featureInterstitialAdWithHtmlPopup - the single callee behind all 24 interstitial call sites - is forced down its existing 'popup blocked' return, so the full-screen ad page and its countdown never open. The host rewrite alone is not enough: the ad URLs are also cached in SharedPreferences under PREF_SLIDER_DATA, and whether to show the page at all comes from remote config, which the app rewrites on every launch. Pairs with Remove Ads, which stops the ad content itself and the AdMob interstitials.

patches_modified.description: Hides banner and native ads and the ad slots in the call log and inbox, and turns off interstitial and app-open ads, so actions such as Click to WhatsApp run at once. Also turns off the remaining ad checks (including rewarded ads), the ad campaign and ad config syncs, and the "Explore Truecaller Premium" row in the contacts list.
patches_modified.previous_description: Hides banner and native ads and turns off interstitial and app-open ads, so actions such as Click to WhatsApp run at once.

patches_modified.name: Disable telemetry
patches_modified.description: Turns off the app start tracker, CleverTap event tracking and AppsFlyer attribution.

patches_modified.name: Disable update prompts
patches_modified.description: Stops the Google Play in-app update prompts and the app's own "update required" page, so the app does not block you from using the patched version.

patches_modified.name: Enable Premium
patches_modified.description: Unlocks the Premium interface and the Premium features that are checked on the device. Features backed by Truecaller's servers (Call Assistant, family sharing, Who viewed / searched for me data, Identify AI, cloud call recording, fraud insurance, the verified badge) are not unlocked.

patches_modified.name: GmsCore support
patches_modified.description: Makes Google sign-in and Google APIs work in the patched app by using MicroG RE instead of Google Play services. Requires MicroG RE to be installed.

patches_modified.name: Hide Assistant tab
patches_modified.description: Turns off the Call Assistant feature, which removes the Assistant tab.

patches_modified.name: Hide Blocking tab
patches_modified.description: Removes the Blocking tab from the bottom bar. Spam blocking keeps working.

patches_modified.name: Hide Premium tab
patches_modified.description: Removes the Premium tab from the bottom bar and the Premium entry from the Settings screen.
patches_modified.previous_description: Removes the Premium tab from the bottom bar.

patches_modified.name: Hide Scam feed
patches_modified.description: Turns off the Scam Feed, which removes its tab and menu entry and stops its notifications.

patches_modified.name: Hide family button
patches_modified.description: Turns off Family Protect, which removes the family button at the top of the home screen and its onboarding and notifications.

patches_modified.name: Restore classic call log
patches_modified.description: Experimental: turns off the redesigned call log, which brings back the classic call log and its "Frequently called" setting.

patches_modified.name: Spoof signature
patches_modified.description: Makes the app report its original signing certificate to itself, so Firebase and Google APIs restricted to the original app keep working.

patches_modified.name: Use SMS for verification codes
patches_modified.description: Reads the phone verification code from the SMS inbox instead of Google's SMS Retriever, for devices without Google Play services or with MicroG. Phone verification can still fail on modified builds, because Truecaller's servers check the app.

patches_modified.name: Ambient light
patches_modified.description: Fills the black bars around the video with a soft glow of the picture's colours, like Ambient light for YouTube. Configurable in Settings > Video and audio > Ambient light.

patches_modified.name: Danmaku comments
patches_modified.description: Flows regular comments, live chat, and chat replays over videos like NicoNico/bilibili, with native in-app settings, NG words, and no API key.

patches_modified.name: Disable Bugsnag Telemetry
patches_modified.description: Makes the Bugsnag SDK discard every error and session report.

patches_modified.name: Disable General Telemetry
patches_modified.description: Skips Pinterest's analytics, attribution, ads measurement and tracking startup tasks.

patches_modified.name: Remove Promoted Pins
patches_modified.description: Makes every pin report itself as not promoted and not an active ad, which disables Pinterest's ad handling for pins.

patches_modified.name: SmartNews cleanup
patches_modified.description: Disables SmartNews ad config, native layouts, and reader ad nodes via stable anchors.

patches_modified.name: Disable pixiv ad SDKs
patches_modified.description: Skips initialization of AppLovin MAX, Google Mobile Ads and Amazon APS to reduce ad-related network traffic.

patches_modified.name: Hide pixiv ads
patches_modified.description: Removes the overlay, list, detail and interstitial ads. Does not unlock Premium features.

patches_modified.name: Auto claim channel points
patches_modified.description: Claim available bonus chests automatically after Twitch's eligibility checks. Coalesces updates and bounds retries for each claim.

patches_modified.name: Block ads
patches_modified.description: Blocks pre-roll, mid-roll and VOD ads, ads stitched into live streams, audio ads, picture-by-picture ads and banner or feed ads, without a third-party server. Can be switched off in the settings.

patches_modified.name: Chat enhancements
patches_modified.description: 7TV, BTTV and FFZ emotes, local word/user filters, repeat filtering, highlights, timestamps and font size. Configure them from the player menu button.

patches_modified.name: Danmaku chat
patches_modified.description: Flows live chat over the stream like NicoNico/bilibili, with emotes and NG words. Long-press the player menu button to switch it on or off.

patches_modified.name: Fix login
patches_modified.description: Optional workaround for the unsupported app/OS login error after re-signing. Skips Twitch's Play Integrity submission; leave off when login works.

patches_modified.name: Fix notifications
patches_modified.description: Repair push registration after re-signing. Adjusts the certificate header only for HTTPS Firebase Installations requests.

patches_modified.name: Player enhancements
patches_modified.description: Playback speed, seek steps, statistics, sleep timer, VOD chat offset and chapters. Optional public manifest proxy, gestures, layout and Following feed controls in the player menu settings.

patches_modified.name: Show deleted messages
patches_modified.description: Keeps deleted or moderated chat messages readable instead of replacing them with "<message deleted>". The message turns into a tappable spoiler: tap it to reveal the original text. Only text already received by this client can be revealed.

patches_added.name: Keep Waze alive on Android Auto
patches_added.description: Keeps Waze running after you disconnect from Android Auto.
